title: 豎井式溢洪道~Shaft spillways
focus: 辨識豎井溢洪道的堰流孔流通氣與控制轉換~Distinguishing shaft-spillway weir orifice ventilation and control transitions
summary: 本課以辨識豎井溢洪道的堰流孔流通氣與控制轉換為主線，先用環形堰頂自由流與喉部孔口控制界定水力與構造條件，再將旋渦環流與水頭、下游管流摩阻連結到瞬變量測與取樣。各算例分屬不同控制工況，不可把自由堰流與滿管流公式同時套在同一斷面。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。~This course develops distinguishing shaft-spillway weir orifice ventilation and control transitions through Circular crest free flow and Throat orifice control, then connects Swirl circulation and head and Downstream conduit friction to Transient measurement and sampling. Examples represent different control regimes; free-weir and full-pipe relations must not be applied simultaneously at one section. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
history: 本課所研究的辨識豎井溢洪道的堰流孔流通氣與控制轉換，反映水工設計由單一尺寸選取走向水流、材料、施工與長期監測共同驗證的發展。各算例分屬不同控制工況，不可把自由堰流與滿管流公式同時套在同一斷面。 美國墾務局官方目錄列有1978年消能工專論、1980年水力試驗技術及1987年小壩設計，這些是技術文件出版年份，不是本課假想工程的啟用日期。所列具名工程只供公開原理與邊界比較，不主張取得其設計圖、現場紀錄或專有參數。~The focus on distinguishing shaft-spillway weir orifice ventilation and control transitions reflects development from isolated sizing toward joint verification of flow, materials, construction and long-term observations. Examples represent different control regimes; free-weir and full-pipe relations must not be applied simultaneously at one section. The Reclamation catalog lists the 1978 energy-dissipator monograph, 1980 hydraulic laboratory techniques and 1987 small-dam manual. These are publication dates, not commissioning dates for a hypothetical project. Named works support comparisons of public principles and boundaries; this course claims no access to proprietary drawings, field records or project parameters.
example: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查環形堰頂自由流：Assumed C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestDiameter=10 m; H=1 m; Q=1.7*pi*10*1**1.5=53.4071 m3/s；再獨立檢查喉部孔口控制：Cd=0.75; throatArea=12 m2; effectiveHead=8 m; Q=0.75*12*sqrt(2*9.81*8)=112.755 m3/s。敏感度：自由堰流近似下水頭由1增至1.5m，流量比為1.5的1.5次方即1.837；若轉為孔口控制且面積不變，同樣水頭比的流量比只有平方根1.225，因此需要確認控制轉換。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。各算例分屬不同控制工況，不可把自由堰流與滿管流公式同時套在同一斷面。 將用同時入出流與水位量測核對庫容變化並檢查率定斜率作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。~Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Circular crest free flow: Assumed C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestDiameter=10 m; H=1 m; Q=1.7*pi*10*1**1.5=53.4071 m3/s. Independently examine Throat orifice control: Cd=0.75; throatArea=12 m2; effectiveHead=8 m; Q=0.75*12*sqrt(2*9.81*8)=112.755 m3/s. Sensitivity: under free-weir control, increasing head from1 to1.5m gives a discharge ratio of1.837. Under fixed-area orifice control the same head ratio gives only1.225. A rating must therefore identify the change in control. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Examples represent different control regimes; free-weir and full-pipe relations must not be applied simultaneously at one section. Use the following independent check: Reconcile simultaneous inflow, outflow and stage change and inspect rating-curve slope. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.

units.anchor: 環形堰頂自由流~Circular crest free flow
units.title: 環形堰頂自由流~Circular crest free flow
units.mechanism: 鐘口入口在低水頭下可近似環形堰流，周長提供有效堰長。接近流旋轉、墩柱與局部淹沒會降低均勻性；示意係數不能跨幾何直接沿用。水頭增加後控制可能移往喉部與隧道，應避免以同一冪次延伸整條率定曲線。 驗證時應沿環形堰頂量測水頭並觀察各方位水舌是否對稱，並辨識以下失效情境：偏心接近流會形成非均勻溢流並改變率定。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~At low head a bellmouth can behave approximately as a circular weir, with circumference supplying crest length. Swirl, piers and submergence reduce uniformity. An illustrative coefficient cannot transfer across geometries, and higher heads may move control to the throat or tunnel rather than preserve one power law. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure head around the circular crest and observe whether nappes are symmetric. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Eccentric approach flow creates nonuniform overflow and changes the rating. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Assumed C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestDiameter=10 m; H=1 m; Q=1.7*pi*10*1**1.5=53.4071 m3/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: Assumed C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestDiameter=10 m; H=1 m; Q=1.7*pi*10*1**1.5=53.4071 m3/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.
units.verify: 沿環形堰頂量測水頭並觀察各方位水舌是否對稱。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「偏心接近流會形成非均勻溢流並改變率定」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。~Measure head around the circular crest and observe whether nappes are symmetric. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Eccentric approach flow creates nonuniform overflow and changes the rating. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.
units.failure: 偏心接近流會形成非均勻溢流並改變率定。診斷時應採取以下查核：沿環形堰頂量測水頭並觀察各方位水舌是否對稱，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。~Eccentric approach flow creates nonuniform overflow and changes the rating. Diagnose it by the following check: Measure head around the circular crest and observe whether nappes are symmetric. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.
units.misconception: 環形堰率定可以延伸到任何高水頭工況~A circular-weir rating remains valid at every high-head condition
units.practice: 交接時以沿環形堰頂量測水頭並觀察各方位水舌是否對稱作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對偏心接近流會形成非均勻溢流並改變率定，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。~At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Measure head around the circular crest and observe whether nappes are symmetric. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Eccentric approach flow creates nonuniform overflow and changes the rating. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

units.anchor: 喉部孔口控制~Throat orifice control
units.title: 喉部孔口控制~Throat orifice control
units.mechanism: 喉部淹沒後可能由有效孔口面積與水頭差控制流量，流量對水頭的反應比自由堰流緩。排氣、下游壓力與流量係數都會影響此關係；孔口公式並不描述控制轉換期間的劇烈波動，需以連續升降流量試驗辨認。 驗證時應在升流與降流過程比較喉部壓力和水位流量曲線，並辨識以下失效情境：控制轉換滯回可能使同水位出現不同流量。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Once submerged, the throat may act as an orifice governed by effective area and head difference. Discharge then responds less strongly to head than free-weir flow. Venting, downstream pressure and coefficient matter, and the equation does not describe unstable transitions between these regimes. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare throat pressure and stage-discharge curves during increasing and decreasing flow. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Transition hysteresis may produce different discharges at the same stage. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Cd=0.75; throatArea=12 m2; effectiveHead=8 m; Q=0.75*12*sqrt(2*9.81*8)=112.755 m3/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: Cd=0.75; throatArea=12 m2; effectiveHead=8 m; Q=0.75*12*sqrt(2*9.81*8)=112.755 m3/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

units.anchor: 豎井通水與空芯~Shaft water area and air core
units.title: 豎井通水與空芯~Shaft water area and air core
units.mechanism: 豎井中沿壁水膜與中央空氣芯可能並存，水量連續應只用液相過水面積。簡化環狀截面忽略含氣與非均勻流速，仍可提醒學生不能將整個井徑都算成水流面積；空芯縮小也會改變通氣和壓力邊界。 驗證時應以影像或含氣探針確認空芯尺寸並核對液相流量，並辨識以下失效情境：空芯收縮可能使原本開放通氣轉成受限流動。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~A wall-attached water layer can surround an air core. Liquid continuity therefore uses the water area rather than the full shaft. A simple annulus omits aeration and velocity variation but shows why air-core changes affect both mean liquid speed and the ventilation boundary. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Use imaging or air probes to establish air-core size and check liquid discharge. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Air-core contraction can turn open ventilation into restricted flow. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：shaftDiameter=5 m; airCoreDiameter=3 m; liquidArea=pi*(5**2-3**2)/4=12.5664 m2。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: shaftDiameter=5 m; airCoreDiameter=3 m; liquidArea=pi*(5**2-3**2)/4=12.5664 m2. units.anchor: 通氣需求與管徑~Vent demand and duct area
units.title: 通氣需求與管徑~Vent demand and duct area
units.mechanism: 水流捲帶空氣進入下游通道，補氣不足會造成低壓與不穩定振盪。給定空氣體積流量與允許平均速度可作截面盤點，不能代替可壓縮流與入口損失分析；空氣體積需標明當地壓力溫度，否則密度與流量不可比。 驗證時應同步記錄通氣管空氣流量與井內絕對壓力，並辨識以下失效情境：鳥網或雜物堵塞會增加通氣阻力並放大負壓。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Entrained air must be replaced through ventilation paths; insufficient supply can cause low pressure and oscillation. Area from specified air volume and speed is only a continuity check, not compressible-flow or inlet-loss analysis. State local pressure and temperature when reporting air volume to preserve comparability. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Record vent airflow and shaft absolute pressure simultaneously. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Screens or debris blockage increases ventilation resistance and deepens subpressure. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 旋渦環流與水頭~Swirl circulation and head
units.title: 旋渦環流與水頭~Swirl circulation and head
units.mechanism: 不對稱接近流可能產生環流與空氣渦，局部旋轉速度會降低中心壓力並影響進流容量。自由渦近似僅在指定半徑之外有效，靠近渦核不能任意外推至無限速度；抗渦構件應以模型驗證其阻水與導流作用。 驗證時應以表面追蹤與速度量測辨識環流方向和渦核範圍，並辨識以下失效情境：只降低平均入流速度可能仍保留強烈環流。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Asymmetric approach flow can create circulation and an air-core vortex. Tangential velocity affects central pressure and inlet capacity. A free-vortex model applies only outside a specified core and cannot be extrapolated to infinite center velocity; test antivortex devices for both flow guidance and obstruction. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Track the surface and measure velocities to identify circulation and core extent. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Reducing mean approach speed alone may leave strong circulation. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 豎井底彎轉動量~Bottom bend momentum change
units.title: 豎井底彎轉動量~Bottom bend momentum change

An equal-speed right-angle vector difference estimates only momentum change. Real support loads also include pressure forces and water weight, so that single component is not the complete bend design load. units.anchor: 下游管流摩阻~Downstream conduit friction
units.title: 下游管流摩阻~Downstream conduit friction
units.mechanism: 當下游通道滿流時，沿程摩阻消耗水頭並可能回控豎井容量；自由水面流則需不同計算架構。達西摩阻係數與管長徑比必須配套使用，接頭、彎道與出入口損失另列，不能因管徑大就忽略整段水頭需求。 驗證時應以沿管壓力測點核對摩阻坡降並辨認是否滿流，並辨識以下失效情境：在明滿流交替時套單一穩態管流式會漏掉壓力跳動。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~A full downstream conduit loses head to friction and may control shaft capacity; free-surface operation needs another framework. Use Darcy friction factor consistently with length-to-diameter ratio and list local losses separately. A large diameter does not eliminate the head demand along a long conduit. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Use pressure taps to check friction gradient and establish whether the conduit is full. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: One steady pipe-flow formula misses pressure changes during mixed free-surface and full flow. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 控制轉換與庫容~Control transition and reservoir storage
units.title: 控制轉換與庫容~Control transition and reservoir storage
units.mechanism: 豎井洩量率定的斜率變小時，新增入流可能更多轉為庫水位上升，應把水庫蓄水方程與溢洪道控制連接。定面積短時近似只表示水量差，不含變動庫容曲線與時間相依洩量；完整洪水演算不能靠單一靜態率定點。 驗證時應用同時入出流與水位量測核對庫容變化並檢查率定斜率，並辨識以下失效情境：延用自由堰流高斜率會低估轉換後水位上升。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~When the discharge-rating slope decreases, more incoming water may become reservoir storage. Couple continuity to the spillway control relation. A constant-area short-interval estimate illustrates imbalance but omits changing storage geometry and time-dependent outflow; one static rating point cannot route a flood. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Reconcile simultaneous inflow, outflow and stage change and inspect rating-curve slope. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Extending the steep free-weir rating understates stage rise after control changes. units.anchor: 漂流物與局部堵塞~Floating debris and local blockage
units.title: 漂流物與局部堵塞~Floating debris and local blockage
units.mechanism: 鐘口附近漂流物可形成環狀或偏心堵塞，既減少有效入口又引入不對稱旋流。單純面積減量只作幾何示意，實際洩量還受堆積形狀與通氣影響；試驗需涵蓋不同漂流物位置以及清除前後的水位反應。 驗證時應以多種堵塞布置觀察偏流旋渦與通氣壓力變化，並辨識以下失效情境：偏心堵塞可能同時削弱洩量與補氣。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Debris around a bellmouth can block the inlet asymmetrically and induce swirl. An area deduction describes geometry only; discharge also depends on accumulation shape and ventilation. Test different positions and examine stage response before and after removal instead of equating blockage area with discharge loss. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Observe asymmetric flow, vortices and ventilation pressures for several blockage layouts. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Eccentric blockage may reduce both discharge and ventilation. units.anchor: 瞬變量測與取樣~Transient measurement and sampling
units.title: 瞬變量測與取樣~Transient measurement and sampling
units.mechanism: 控制轉換伴隨的壓力振盪可能比水位平均變化快，量測系統需足夠採樣率並處理抗混疊。奈奎斯特條件只是避免理想頻率折疊的最低要求，不代表波形與尖峰已被精確重建；需根據實際頻帶與感測器響應安排記錄。 驗證時應以較高採樣率對照頻譜並測試感測器動態響應，並辨識以下失效情境：未濾波的高頻振動可能折疊成假低頻壓力週期。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Pressure oscillations during control transitions may be faster than mean stage changes. Sampling and anti-alias filtering must cover the relevant band. Nyquist is a minimum ideal condition, not a guarantee of accurate waveform or peak reconstruction; account for the sensor response and observed frequency content. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare spectra at a higher rate and test the pressure sensor dynamic response. sources.title: 美國墾務局水工手冊與專論目錄
sources.scope: 官方目錄核實 1978 消能工專論、1980 水力試驗技術、1987 小壩設計及1990氣蝕專論；目錄日期不是工程啟用年。
sources.scopeEn: Official catalog verifies the 1978 dissipator monograph, 1980 laboratory techniques, 1987 small-dam manual and 1990 cavitation monograph; publication dates are not project commissioning dates.

sources.title: 美國墾務局設計標準官方入口
sources.scope: 官方章節目錄包括反濾、滲流、監測、地震及溢洪道；適用性仍需地方規範及專案評估。
sources.scopeEn: Official chapters include filters, seepage, monitoring, seismic design and spillways; applicability still requires local codes and project assessment.

sources.title: USACE 溢洪道水力設計手冊
sources.scope: 官方索引核實EM1110-2-1603與1990年日期；直接頁面取回受限，不聲稱全文閱讀。
sources.scopeEn: Official index verifies EM1110-2-1603 and its 1990 date; direct retrieval was restricted, and full-text review is not claimed.

sources.title: 蒙蒂塞洛壩與鐘口溢洪道業主資料
sources.titleEn: Monticello Dam and morning-glory spillway owner facts
sources.scope: 業主確認Monticello鐘口型溢洪道與1957年建壩；課程幾何水頭均另行假設，不以公開庫容作演算。
sources.scopeEn: Owner confirms the morning-glory spillway and 1957 dam construction; course geometry and heads are assumed, and public storage is not used in calculations.

sources.title: 格倫峽谷壩業主資料
sources.scope: 業主資料確認壩、進水、壓力管與溢洪道的系統脈絡；不採公開庫容當本課合成模型的輸入。
sources.scopeEn: Owner information confirms dam, intake, penstock and spillway context; public storage figures are not inputs to synthetic lesson models.
